items.item_text: Current and active California Occupational Therapist (OT) license
Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross (ARC)
Candidates with more than two (2) years of relevant occupational therapy experience may qualify for the Occupational Therapist II (OT II) title.

At UCLA Health, our comprehensive team of highly skilled and compassionate rehab professionals is giving new life to thousands of people every year. We do it by transforming our passion for life into leading-edge rehab advancements and achievements. Join us and make a vital contribution to others’ lives.
In this role, you'll be responsible for evaluation and treatment of patients on the occupational therapy caseload in the hospital setting.
Major duties include: patient evaluation, patient treatment, meeting documentation requirements, and maintaining expected productivity levels.
Graduate from an accredited Occupational Therapy program
